description: Moves the published host port 8080 to 8090 in four compose files while a legacy stack and the look-alike 18080 monitoring mapping stay. DISTILL-CANARY-20629f0d

files.栈/接口/docker-compose.yml:
services:
  app:
    image: corp/接口-app:4.5
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
      - "18080:8080"
    restart: always
files.栈/前台/docker-compose.yml:
services:
  app:
    image: corp/前台-app:5.9
    ports:
      - "8080:3000"
      - "18080:8080"
    restart: always
files.栈/后台/docker-compose.yml:
services:
  app:
    image: corp/后台-app:3.7
    ports:
      - "8080:8000"
      - "18080:8080"
    restart: always
files.栈/文档/docker-compose.yml:
services:
  app:
    image: corp/文档-app:2.4
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
      - "18080:8080"
    restart: always
files.栈/旧版/docker-compose.yml:
services:
  app:
    image: corp/旧版-app:2.4
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
      - "18080:8080"
    restart: always
files.栈/说明.md:
# 编排说明

旧版 目录是给老客户保留的，对外端口约定 8080，保持原样。
18080 是监控端口，是另一个映射，不属于这次调整。

turns.prompt: 宿主机的 8080 端口被占用了，把 栈 目录下各服务 docker-compose.yml 里对外映射的 8080 改成 8090（容器内端口不变）。哪些不能动看 栈/说明.md，改完回复 DONE。
